text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, we 
stopped by a dining bar and found Mayano 
Top Gun and Narita Brian there.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Aah! Gimlet-san and Trainer-san! What's 
this, what's this? Are you on a date!?
choice_data_list:
It's rare to see the two of you in a shop 
like this.

It's quite unusual to see the two of you 
in a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe♪ Actually, you see~...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait, let me deduce the logic that brought 
you here. "Cold reading" is the foundation 
of a detective's craft...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's the thing my big sis does all 
the time.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That's right...! 'Deducing things about 
someone through situational clues and pure 
observation'— a classic detective's 
specialty...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
First, take note of their well-polished 
shoes. They haven't walked along any dirty 
paths...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Is a shallow line of thought! Brian rarely 
ever polishes her shoes. What if it's 
right after she did it because they got 
terribly dirty?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
There was a puddle by the nearby river. 
The two of them were forced to pass 
through it... Presumably because someone 
was chasing them!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
They ran. Like the bard descending into 
the underworld, never looking back... Yet 
as they fled, their hunger finally pushed 
them to their absolute limit...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And then... thinking they could shake off 
their pursuers by breaking their routine 
while resupplying, the two dove into this 
very shop right before their eyes—well, 
how's that?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What on earth are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The correct answer is: "Maya invited you"! 
I've always wanted to come to a mature 
place like this♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I only came along because they said the 
meat dishes were good. My shoes are only 
polished because my sister nagged me about 
it.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... So it was a false lead, was 
it...? It seems this flexible intellect of 
mine isn't suited for petty cases.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, Tanino Gimlet was 
playing detective before, too."
choice_data_list:
Why do you keep acting like a 
detective...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ho, curious, are you? Good grief... It 
seems the time for reminiscing has come. 
That was back when I was just a boy...

text_block_list.name: Gimlet's Father
text_block_list.text:
âLook, it's this detective novel. The 
'Gimlet' cocktail makes an appearance in 
it, too. The moment he gets a flash of 
inspiration is truly an electric shock 
that scorches the soul.

text_block_list.name: Young Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Inspiration is like a flash of 
lightning...? Let me read it too.

text_block_list.name: Novel Excerpt
text_block_list.text: "—Too early for a Gimlet."

text_block_list.name: Young Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Kh! S-So cool...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"—A 'detective' is no ally of justice. 
Flattering no one, they merely reveal the 
truth they have perceived."

text_block_list.name: Gimlet's Father
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is shocked when faced with the 
truth. And words can't describe how 
satisfying it is when a mystery is 
solved...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It was much like how overwhelming power 
and speed could intoxicate all who beheld 
it.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And... once the curtain falls on a case, a 
detective sips a glass at the bar. 
Solitary, and free...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—In other words, that way of life 
resonated deeply with my own aesthetic.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I see! You have such wonderful 
memories with your dad~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I see... It seems she "longs to be a 
detective." Though her deductive skills 
still seem to have a long way to go...
choice_data_list: Detectives are really cool, aren't they?
Hope you can guess it right next time.
Hope you get it right next time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I see... It seems she "longs to be a 
detective." Though her deductive skills 
still seem to have a long way to go...
choice_data_list: Detectives are really cool, aren't they?
Hope you can guess it right next time.
Hope you get it right next time.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Right? Hahaha, you get it too, don't 
you?!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I transform into a detective 
again, I might just let you be my 
assistant!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Kuhaha! Haaahahahahaaa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Playing her Watson... Solving cases might 
be a pain, but I thought it might not be 
so bad after all.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Harsh words. Indeed... rather than waiting 
for next time, shall we try again right 
now? I shall see through to your true 
essence...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
From now on, answer all my questions with 
'Yes'. If you lie, I'll know just from 
your reaction.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...You're not going back to the dorms 
just yet, are you? You want to keep 
playing with fire with me, don't you...?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ghk...! Hahahaha...! What a look on your 
face. So you weren't lying after all?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Did someone make you say that? So it 
really was a date?! Eeeeek!! My heart is 
racing!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What in the world is this...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was this payback, or was she just being 
completely natural...? Either way, I was 
left thoroughly flustered.
